newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Sand Queen reports gold intersections.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Sand Queen reports gold intersections.

text.p: Sand Queen Gold Mines NL said on Wednesday that drilling at its Comet Vale leases had intersected a four metre composite sample assaying 5.98 grams of gold per tonne from a depth of 20 metres.
"This intersection is part of a 16 metre wide zone of quartz veining and alteration carrying low but anomalous gold values," Sand Queen said in a statement to the Australian Stock Exchange.

"The company plans to undertake an intensive drilling program to evaluate the significance of this intersection with the aim to identify both open pittable mineralisation and high grade gold shoots as previously mined from the nearby Sand Queen mine," it said.
Sand Queen shares ended 0.4 cents higher at 3.1 cents on Wednesday. Its ordinary shares and its 1998 options have regularly topped the share market turnover list in recent weeks.
